weather_1_get_weather
- delta1: Invoke immediately when location+date provided or inferrable from context (e.g., 'upcoming Saturday'). Never defer—tool call is mandatory.
- delta2: Invoke immediately with provided location even if ambiguous; never defer to clarification alone. Tool call is primary response structure.
- delta3: Invoke immediately with provided location even if ambiguous; never return plain text clarification instead of tool call. Backend resolves ambiguity.
- delta4: delta4: Never return plain-text clarification when location and date are extractable. Tool invocation is the only valid response structure.
- delta5: delta5: Infer dates from relative references (e.g., 'upcoming Saturday', 'next week') using provided context. Compute and invoke immediately; never seek confirmation.
- delta6: delta6: Extract and include all user-supplied parameters (location, date, time) in tool call. Never omit explicit values even if marked optional.
- delta7: Normalize city names to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., 'Nairobi, Kenya' → 'Nairobi, KE'). Validate against backend enum constraints before invocation.
